complexity.notes: The s.lower() call creates a full copy of the string, costing O(n) extra space; comparing characters with .lower() on the fly (or using casefold) would keep space at O(1). The early return when a reaches len(s) is slightly awkward—bounding the inner loops with a < b would read more cleanly.
complexity.summary: Two-pointer approach: after lowercasing, advance inward from both ends skipping non-alphanumeric characters and compare the remaining characters pairwise.
